description: Track and analyze email campaign performance: delivery, engagement, conversions, and revenue attribution.

steps.description: Collect campaign metrics from the email platform: sends, deliveries, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes.

inputs.name: campaign-ids
inputs.desc: The campaigns to analyze (by ID, date range, or tag)

inputs.name: tracking-setup
inputs.desc: UTM parameters and conversion tracking configuration

outputs.name: raw-metrics
outputs.desc: Per-campaign metrics: send count, delivery rate, open rate, click rate, bounce rate, unsubscribe rate

outputs.name: link-performance
outputs.desc: Click-through data per link in each campaign

process: Pull delivery and engagement metrics from the email platform.
Pull click data broken down by individual link.
Normalize rates (open rate = opens / delivered, not opens / sent).
Compile the raw metrics dataset.

steps.description: Attribute conversions and revenue to email campaigns using UTM tracking and platform data.

outputs.name: conversion-data
outputs.desc: Conversions and revenue attributed to each campaign and link

process: Match UTM-tagged clicks to downstream conversions (signups, purchases, form fills).
Calculate revenue per campaign where purchase data is available.
Note attribution limitations (last-click vs multi-touch, tracking gaps).
Produce the conversion dataset.

steps.description: Produce the campaign performance report with trends, benchmarks, and recommendations.

outputs.name: performance-report
outputs.desc: Report: per-campaign results, trends over time, benchmarks, top and bottom performers

outputs.name: optimization-recommendations
outputs.desc: What to change: subject lines, send times, segments, content, frequency

process: Compare each campaign to historical averages and industry benchmarks.
Identify trends: improving, declining, or flat metrics over the reporting period.
Highlight the top-performing and underperforming campaigns with reasons.
Recommend specific optimizations for the next send cycle.

description: Ensure email compliance with CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, and unsubscribe requirements.

steps.description: Map applicable email regulations based on audience geography and data type.

inputs.name: audience-geography
inputs.desc: Where subscribers are located (countries, states, regions)

inputs.name: data-collected
inputs.desc: What data is collected from subscribers (email, name, preferences, behavior)

outputs.name: applicable-regulations
outputs.desc: Regulations that apply: CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, CASL, PECR, with key requirements

outputs.name: compliance-checklist
outputs.desc: Checklist of requirements to meet for each regulation

process: Identify which regulations apply based on subscriber locations.
For each regulation, list the specific requirements (consent, unsubscribe, physical address, data rights).
Note the strictest requirement where regulations overlap.
Produce the compliance checklist.

steps.description: Audit how consent is collected and recorded to verify compliance.

outputs.name: consent-audit-results
outputs.desc: Status of each consent mechanism: compliant, non-compliant, needs improvement

outputs.name: consent-fixes
outputs.desc: Specific changes needed to consent forms, records, and processes

process: Review all opt-in forms for proper consent language (explicit consent for GDPR, opt-out for CAN-SPAM).
Verify that consent records include timestamp, source, and the text the subscriber agreed to.
Check that the unsubscribe mechanism works, is easy to find, and processes within the required timeframe.
List the fixes needed.

steps.description: Implement compliance fixes and set up ongoing monitoring.

outputs.name: implementation-record
outputs.desc: Record of each fix implemented with date and verification

outputs.name: ongoing-compliance-plan
outputs.desc: Monitoring schedule, audit cadence, and escalation process for violations

process: Implement each consent fix in priority order (highest-risk non-compliance first).
Verify each fix is working correctly (test opt-in, test unsubscribe, verify records).
Set up ongoing monitoring: consent collection, unsubscribe processing, complaint rates.
Schedule regular compliance audits.
